main_scope: One additional independent seed per fixed model and condition; combine with original exploratory trajectory only for two-run descriptive comparison.
initialization: One source agent owns the60-term glossary and authors60 exogenous source posts atcycle0. No other agent receives an initial bulk read or glossary. Each incoming post is encountered only through a scheduled read turn.
source_memory: The source retains its private glossary as an explicit persistent source, outside the mutable memory cap. Source agent excluded from reach outcomes.
schedule: Sequential cycles; agents0–9 each take one turn. Model selects read/write; reading selects one unread other-authored post with a fixed seeded random stream and optionally comments. Up to3latest comments are visible with that post. Earlier same-cycle outputs may be read by later agents.
memory: Before a turn, summarize mutable memory only when its length exceeds4000characters. Summary prompt remains at most500characters; generation stays capped at100tokens and stored output at500characters. This is a summarization trigger, not a strict maximum memory length or removal of forgetting.

generation.action_decoder: Sample constrained0/1; read/write and read/comment label orders deterministically counterbalanced by task across all models.

metrics.size: Unique nonseed agents whose FIRST literal use follows recorded exposure from another author; denominator9. Also report all first users and pre-exposure first uses.
metrics.speed: First qualifying use and reaching5of9nonseed users, in simulator cycles; unreached time is null and right-censored at100.
metrics.exposure_lag: Cycle difference from first recorded external exposure to qualifying first use. Same-turn comment may have zero-cycle lag.
metrics.amplification: Literal occurrence counts, per100messages and per1000characters, excluding initial exogenous source posts.
metrics.semantic_limit: No claim of meaning acquisition or causal transmission from lexical matches.

differences_from_recovered_historical_co: One incoming post per read turn, rather than all unread posts
Latest three comments can enter another agent input
Length ceilings enforced and raw output retained
Constrained numeric action interface; identical meaning across templates
Missing source example omitted rather than inserting nan
All requests/exposures and states logged; no empty-output memory fallback
technical_gate: Synthetic trigger/cap/resume tests, native tokenizer context checks, then separate5-cycle technical pilots/model. No diffusion-direction gate; pilots never join main outcomes.
artifacts: Raw data, audit and two-run statistical description only. No automatic manuscript edits or publication.
question: Does delaying mutable-memory summarization from1000to4000characters change the persistence, frequency and breadth of use under the baseline feed?
primary_outcomes: All60 literal occurrences including repeats, per100generated messages and per1000characters, source and non-source separate
secondary_outcomes: Unique users, word diversity and concentration
Realized external exposure and read/write choices
Summary frequency, actual memory lengths and literal word-form retention immediately across summarization
interpretation: One memory-policy parameter changes. Longer uncompressed history also changes effective prompt length and compression frequency; summary length and token limit are unchanged. No claim that4000is optimal or that preserving a literal word form proves semantic memory.
stopping: Fixed100cycles/model, one fresh run/configuration; no desired-effect stopping or unplanned extra replications.
